preconditions.description: The input must be a string.

postconditions.expression: all(c.isupper() for c in camel_case(input_string) if camel_case(input_string).index(c) == i and (i == 0 or camel_case(input_string)[i-1] == ' '))
postconditions.description: The first letter of each word in the output string is capitalized, where words are defined as sequences separated by spaces in the input.

postconditions.expression: camel_case(input_string).replace(' ', '') == ''.join(c for c in input_string if c != ' ')
postconditions.description: All spaces in the input string are removed in the output.

postconditions.expression: camel_case(input_string) == ''.join(c.upper() if i == 0 or input_string[i-1] == ' ' else c.lower() for i, c in enumerate(input_string) if c != ' ')
postconditions.description: The output string is formed by capitalizing the first letter of each word (after removing spaces) and lowercasing the rest of the letters in the word.
